newsitem.title: USA: Enron expects Qatar agreement this spring.
newsitem.headline: Enron expects Qatar agreement this spring.

text.p: Enron Corp expects to reach agreement on a $4 billion, five million metric ton per year liquefied natural gas project in Qatar later this spring, Chairman Kenneth Lay said on Tuesday.
Lay said all of the LNG production from the Enron International project in Qatar's North Dome field is expected to be exported to India to meet rising demand in industrial states there.
"It looks like that market can take the first five million metric tons or more in the first year," he told reporters after the company's annual meeting here.

Energy demand in India is being fueled in part by Enron's Dabhol power project, which includes an 826 megawatt plant in phase one and a 1,624 megawatt LNG power plant and regasification facility in phase two, he said.
Lay said he did not expect the Qatar project to export LNG to Israel because of the rising demand in India. "Originally Qatar was hopeful some would go to Israel," he said.
